title: Kanda 16: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 16.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 16.

verses.original: अपेहि मनसस्पतेऽप क्राम परश्चर । परो निर्ऋत्या आ चक्ष्व तं नः परि पाहि ॥
verses.transliteration: apehi manasaspate'pa krāma paraścara | paro nirṛtyā ā cakṣva taṁ naḥ pari pāhi ||
verses.translation: Depart, O torment of the mind! Move away, wander far into distance! Look toward misery far off, and preserve our peaceful sanity!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The Shanti prayer dispelling anxiety, mental anguish, and dark depressive shadows.

layers.author: whitney
